devdoc.author: Renzo Protocol
devdoc.details: Handles native ETH payments to be split among recipients.          A list of payment addresses and their corresponding amount to be paid out are tracked.          As ETH payments come in, they are split among the recipients until the amount to be paid is completed.          After all recipients are paid, any new ETH is sent to the fallback address.          ERC20 tokens are simply forwarded to the fallback address and can be triggered by any address.

params._initialAmountOwed: Initial amount owed to the recipient - can be set to 0

params._amount: Amount to add to outstanding balance owed
params._recipient: Recipient address to increase the amount owed

params.token: IERC20 that was sent to this contract

params._fallbackPaymentAddress: The address where all funds will be sent after recipients are fully paid

NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._amount: Amount to subtract from the outstanding balance owed
params._recipient: Recipient address to decrease the amount owed
